messages:
sara (security): Alert from audit-bot: multiple recent DB snapshots uploaded with no SSE header after RBAC change. pinging infra + storage.
dan (backup-agent): which snapshots? I see uploads from my agent v3 between 2026-03-25T02:00 and 02:12Z. example key: backups/prod/db1/snap-2026-03-25-0202.tar.lz4, metadata shows "sse": null and "kms_key_alias": "".
priya (eng-storage): that's the agent that switched to using a new service account yesterday. did we remove kms:Encrypt on purpose for that principal?
leo (eng-infra): we changed the service-account role policy to tighten S3 put permissions and rotated credentials. looks like we accidentally removed kms:GenerateDataKey permission in the role merge.
dan (backup-agent): oh no — agent fell back to plain PUT after failing KMS call. I have logs: "GenerateDataKey failed: AccessDenied" then PutObject proceeded without SSE.
audit-bot: Rule encops-19 triggered: detected S3 objects in backups-prod with ServerSideEncryption==null for last 24h. Count: 6.
sara (security): immediate actions: 1) suspend backup agent writes to backups-prod 2) rotate the compromised snapshots' keys (consider tenant-level key rotation) 3) notify CISO and open incident ticket 4) require evidence of deletion or re-encrypt for copies if any cross-account replication occurred.
leo (eng-infra): applying temporary IAM change: re-add kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Encrypt to service-account role; blocking outgoing replication for backup buckets; will also add a policy to S3 to require x-amz-server-side-encryption header.
priya (eng-storage): once infra restores KMS perms, agent will retry with GenerateDataKey and PutObject with SSE-KMS. I'll run a scan to find objects missing SSE and schedule a rewrite job to re-encrypt any object we control.
dan (backup-agent): I pushed a patch to agent v3 to fail-safe: abort uploads if encryption fails and emit a hard error instead of plaintext PUT. Rolling out hotfix now.
sara (security): good. follow-ups for postmortem: - add CI guard to prevent role merges that remove KMS perms - weekly SSE enforcement audit - require signed transfer receipts for any cross-account copy - update runbook for service-account role change.
audit-bot: Note: created incident INC-2026-149, tagged encryption-exposure.
leo (eng-infra): actions done: role patched, bucket policy staged, agent hotfix rolling. will confirm re-encrypt job and CloudTrail export in the incident.
sara (security): thanks. keep updates in INC-2026-149 and do not share keys in chat.
